_notes: kind picks the reader in grooming.py. tz: winter UTC offset, and whether the resort follows US daylight time (Alberta stays on UTC-6).
page: the map page in app/ whose run names, guessed grooming and pods the log matches against (app/aliases/<page>.json for spellings).
model: the mid-mountain point Open-Meteo is sampled at. snotel: the nearest NRCS station (the same ones as snowtrack).
Checks run three times a day from the workflow (14:30, 17:30 and 20:30 UTC), after the morning reports post, with a re-check later.

_not_collected.baker: Mt. Baker publishes no per-run grooming (checked 2026-11-22): its snow report has one free-text surface line for the whole mountain and a per-chair table, and archived reports from Jan and Feb 2026 have no grooming list either.
